mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS shows a positive month-over-month change, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 7.5%, it signals a strong labor market and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary accommodation and labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE < 7.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, defined by residential investment (HOUST) above 800 and industrial production (INDPRO) above 95, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 800 AND INDPRO > 95, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low month-over-month change in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals stable inflation, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL shows a low month-over-month change, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.0%, it signals a tightening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (HOUST) is above 800 and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 95, it signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 800 AND INDPRO > 95, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
